items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Yeah, Floyd O'Brien made that record.

ctx.x: Yeah, Floyd O'Brien is who played trombone. I always get that record mixed up with the ones I made with Wingy because it was a mixed band. They both were mixed bands. I was playing and I'd get them mixed up sometimes. Yeah, Floyd O'Brien made that record.
Was that many mixed bands playing around New York or just recording sessions?
